characters.summary: Estë the Gentle is one of the Valar, the Vala of healing, rest, and peace. She does not fight in conventional physical battles, instead residing in the gardens of Lórien where she heals weariness and hurt.

mechanisms: Residing in the protected sanctuary of Valinor

mobility: Standard Valian movement / teleportation across realms
limitations: Not a combatant; her power is directed toward healing and rest rather than offensive combat.

sources.supports: Estë's status as one of the Valar and Queen of Lórien.

feats.claim: Heals weariness and hurt of body and spirit in the gardens of Lórien.

campaignTags.claim: Estë is the Vala of healing and rest, restoring weariness.

unknowns: Specific active combat applications of her healing or power beyond restorative rest are not detailed in the texts.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings / J.R.R. Tolkien Legendarium
characters.summary: Faramir is a skilled Captain of Gondor, combining martial prowess, tactical leadership, and deep wisdom. He fights with sword, bow, and stealthy guerrilla tactics against the forces of Mordor.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to ordinary mortal harm and severe illness like the Black Breath.

sources.supports: Faramir's role as Captain of Gondor and combat background.

feats.claim: Led the Rangers of Ithilien in harassing attacks against Haradrim and Orc forces.
feats.citation: The Two Towers, Of Herbs and Stewed Rabbit

notableResults.note: Successful ambushes in Ithilien with his rangers.
Retreating from Osgiliath, wounded and overcome by the Black Breath.

campaignTags.claim: Leads the Rangers of Ithilien in covert operations and tracking behind enemy lines.
Expert in stealth and guerrilla tactics in the woods of Ithilien.

unknowns: Exact number of individual combat victories.

characters.summary: Fingolfin was High King of the Noldor, renowned as the most valiant and steadfast of the elven princes. He fought a legendary single combat against Morgoth, wounding the Dark Lord seven times.
weaknesses: Exhaustion from single combat against a cosmic-tier adversary.
limitations: Mortal elven endurance against divine physical might.

sources.supports: Fingolfin's duel with Morgoth and his status as High King.

feats.claim: Wounded Morgoth seven times with his sword Ringil and caused the Dark Lord to limp permanently.
feats.citation: The Silmarillion, Of the Ruin of Beleriand and the Fingolfin's Fall

notableResults.note: Single combat at the gates of Angband; Fingolfin was slain after exhausting himself and being crushed.

campaignTags.claim: Rode his great horse Rochallor into combat against Morgoth.

unknowns: Full extent of Ringil's enchantments beyond cold and brightness.

characters.summary: Finrod Felagund was King of Nargothrond, wise, noble, and a master of song and mind-craft. He fought fiercely with bare hands against a werewolf in Sauron's dungeons to protect Beren.
weaknesses: Bound by oath and honor, vulnerable to physical overpower without weapons.
limitations: Cannot withstand the combined sorcery and physical might of Sauron indefinitely without aid.

sources.supports: Finrod's duel of song against Sauron and defense of Beren.

feats.claim: Fought and killed a werewolf barehanded in the dungeons of Tol-in-Gaurhoth.
feats.citation: The Silmarillion, Of Beren and Lúthien

notableResults.note: Engaged in a magical song-duel of power against Sauron and was defeated.

campaignTags.claim: Communicated silently and resisted Sauron's mental assaults through song and willpower.

unknowns: The exact limits of his song-craft outside of direct confrontation with Sauron.

characters.summary: Finwë was the first High King of the Noldor, leading his people on the Great Journey to Valinor. He was a wise ruler and father to Fëanor, Fingolfin, and Finarfin.

techniques: Standard elven weaponry and martial defense

mechanisms: Elven armor and royal guard protection

weaknesses: Relatively aged and isolated during the assault by Melkor.
limitations: Limited active combat feats late in life.

sources.supports: Finwë's status as High King of the Noldor and his death defending his home.

feats.claim: Refused to flee and stood alone at the doors of Formenos to defend against Melkor before being slain.
feats.citation: The Silmarillion, Of the Flight of the Noldor

notableResults.note: Slain by Melkor at the doors of Formenos when the Silmarils were stolen.

unknowns: His combat prowess during his younger days in Valinor.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings / J.R.R. Tolkien Legendarium
characters.summary: Frodo Baggins is a Hobbit of the Shire who undertook the quest to destroy the One Ring. He relies primarily on stealth, endurance, and the protective or corruptive powers of the Ring rather than direct combat.

mechanisms: The One Ring (invisibility at the cost of corruption)

weaknesses: Hobbit physical frailty, vulnerability to psychological corruption by the One Ring, and susceptibility to mortal wounds.
limitations: Limited physical strength and stamina compared to Men, Elves, or Orcs.

sources.supports: Frodo's role, use of Sting, Mithril coat, and the One Ring.

feats.claim: Stabbed a cave troll's foot in Moria with Sting.
feats.citation: The Fellowship of the Ring, The Bridge of Khazad-dûm

notableResults.note: Stabbed the troll's foot, though saved primarily by his Mithril coat from a lethal spear thrust.
Wounded on Weathertop by the Morgul-blade.

conditional.ability: Near-invulnerability against ordinary piercing/blunt strikes to the torso

campaignTags.claim: Becomes invisible to normal sight when putting on the One Ring.
Bears the One Ring and wears a shirt of Mithril mail.
Utilizes hobbit natural stealth and the One Ring to evade enemies.

unknowns: Full extent of his resistance to mental domination without external help.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings / J.R.R. Tolkien Legendarium
characters.summary: Galadriel is one of the mightiest and fairest of the Elves in Middle-earth, possessing immense wisdom, telepathic power, and mastery over magic. She can protect realms, peer into minds, and break enemy fortifications.

mechanisms: Nenya (Ring of Power providing concealment and preservation)

weaknesses: Bound by the limitations of Middle-earth and the fading of elven power without her ring.
limitations: Power is primarily defensive and preservative within Middle-earth unless amplified or applied strategically.

sources.supports: Galadriel's magical powers, role in Lothlórien, and dismantling of Dol Guldur.

feats.claim: Pulled down the walls of Dol Guldur and laid bare its pits during the War of the Ring.
feats.citation: The Fellowship of the Ring / Appendix B

notableResults.citation: The Return of the King, Appendix B
notableResults.note: Cleared and dismantled the stronghold of Dol Guldur.

conditional.ability: Preservation and warding of Lothlórien against outside evil

campaignTags.claim: Wields potent elven magic and bears Nenya, the Ring of Adamant.
Bears Nenya, one of the Three Elven Rings.
Communicates telepathically and reads the minds of the Fellowship.

unknowns: Full extent of her direct combat offensive spellcasting in physical duels.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings / J.R.R. Tolkien Legendarium
characters.summary: Gandalf the Grey / White is an Istar (Maiar spirit incarnate) wielding fire, light, and powerful spellcasting alongside mastery of the sword Glamdring. He is a primary tactician and combatant against Sauron's forces.
weaknesses: Restricted by the physical limitations of his mortal old-man body as an Istar.
limitations: Bound by the Valar not to match Sauron's power with direct tyranny; physical fatigue in mortal form.

sources.supports: Gandalf's identity as a Maiar, spellcasting, swordplay, and battle feats.

feats.claim: Defeated the Balrog of Moria after a multi-day subterranean battle.
feats.citation: The Two Towers, The White Rider

notableResults.note: Fought from the depths of Moria to the peak of Zirakzigil, resulting in both their physical deaths (though Gandalf was sent back as Gandalf the White).
Held off multiple Nazgûl overnight with bolts of fire and light.

conditional.dependsOn: Wielding Narya, the Ring of Fire

campaignTags.claim: Produces lightning and dazzling flashes during combat.
Wields the Ring of Fire Narya and generates magical fire and explosions.
Controls and commands fire for offensive blasts and signals.
Is an Istar wizard capable of wide-ranging spellcasting and enchantments.
Wields Glamdring and Narya, the Ring of Fire.
Casts spells including light seals, locking charms, and fire bursts.

unknowns: The full extent of his unconstrained Maiar power outside his Istar bodily limits.
